newsitem.title: USA: Iowa unemployment rate falls to 3.2 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Iowa unemployment rate falls to 3.2 pct in March.

text.p: Iowa's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate dropped to 3.2 percent in March from 3.5 percent in February, the state's workforce development office reported.

Iowa set a record for the second consecutive month for total employment at more than 1.57 million, largely from gains in the services, trade and durable goods sectors, Director Cynthia Eisenhauer said in a prepared statement released Thursday.
The U.S. unemployment rate for March was 5.2 percent. Iowa had a seasonally adjusted rate of 3.7 percent for March 1996.
